metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-ej[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Publish agents and beads sidecars asynchronously from an axe chop[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`sase commit` never blocks on agents/beads sidecar publication. It [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]records durable publication requests and returns, while a dedicated[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]axe lumberjack drains those requests, and `just check` stays green [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]while requests are still pending.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]async_sidecar_publication.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/async_sidecar_publication.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-ej[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-ej/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bound the agent-name registry source scan[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]scanfix[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]scanfix: eliminate the per-lookup rescan of ~17k dismissed bundles and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]every agent artifact directory that makes plan-association resolution [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]CPU-bound, which is the concrete stall reported by sase-cl.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Durable sidecar publication queue[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]queue[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]queue: generalize the agents publication outbox into a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]workspace-independent, per-project queue that also records pending [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bead-page and plan-header publication work, with enqueue, drain, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]quarantine, and retire semantics.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]publications lumberjack and sidecar_publication chop[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]chop[dim] · [dim][/dim]after queue[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]chop: add the new axe lumberjack plus the builtin chop that drains the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]queue for every project, in agents -> beads -> plan-header order, under [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bounded per-project locks, work budgets, and exponential backoff.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rewire commit and other writers to mark instead of publish[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]commit[dim] · [dim][/dim]after queue, chop[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]commit: convert `sase commit` and every remaining synchronous [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]agents/beads sidecar writer into enqueue-only callers so no interactive [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]command performs sidecar git work.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Keep validation green while publication is pending[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]validate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after commit[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]validate: remove the dead prompt-to-plan link validation and make every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]remaining prompt-archive and plan check tolerant of a non-empty [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]publication queue so `just check` never depends on sidecar publication.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Observability, docs, and sase-cl closure[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]land[dim] · [dim][/dim]after scanfix, chop, commit, validate[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]land: surface queue health in doctor and ACE, refresh the axe and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]configuration documentation, verify the stall is gone end to end, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]close the sase-cl bead with that evidence.[/#D7D7AF]
